title: MORE MORE JUMP! Chapter1 Episode2 The Idol I Admire!

rows.Line: Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Still no notification...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I wonder if I've failed another audition...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, I can't think like that! There's still a chance! This time'll be different for sure!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! Finally!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Please... Oh, please...
Here goes!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Nngh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Rejected again!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mom
rows.Line:
Minori, your father and I are leaving soon.
Don't forget to lock up.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, Mom. Wait, is that the time?!
I'm gonna be late!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - School Gate

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Phew, I can't believe I made it.
But still...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (This makes fifty rejections. I thought I had a shot after I passed their first round of applications, too.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (There I go again! Stop that! There's no use complaining over what's already happened!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (ASRUN's Haruka said it herself!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Tomorrow will always be a better day!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So in order to help everyone believe things can always get better...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm here to give everyone hope for a better tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (This audition may not have worked out, but who knows what might happen next time!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: All right! I just need to try harder! More, more, more!

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Minori! Did you see the news?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hm? No, I was kinda busy this morning.
Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: They're saying ASRUN has disbanded and Haruka Kiritani is retiring from singing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-Whaaat?!
Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: ASRUN is disbanding...and Haruka Kiritani is retiring.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But Haruka is the only reason I've been able to keep trying all this time. Why now?!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I don't know what to think anymore...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Hey, doesn't that girl in the hall look kind of like Haruka Kiritani?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Huh? That IS her! What's she doing here?!
She's going into Class C!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Female Teacher
rows.Line: Ms. Kiritani, are you sure you want to switch to the general education course? Since you've already earned some, you could remain in the credit-based course.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure. I'm just a regular high school student now.
Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Female Teacher
rows.Line: All right, everyone. Settle down.

rows.Speaker: Female Teacher
rows.Line: We have a new student joining us today. Ms. Kiritani, would you please introduce yourself to the class?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: My name is Haruka Kiritani. I was enrolled here during junior high school, but haven't really attended classes since starting high school because of work.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: However, I recently decided to quit in order to return to school and finish my education. It's nice to meet you all.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
H-Haruka?
No way!

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: This is crazy! It's really Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: No fair! How come she couldn't be in our class?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Man, look at this crowd! I can't see a thing. I still can't believe Haruka is actually a student here.
Crazy, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Urgh... I can't stand it!
I feel like I'm splitting in two!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Y-You're going to split in two?! Minori, are you all right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: S-Sorry, I'm just so overwhelmed right now that I don't know how to feel.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Seeing Haruka right here in front of me almost makes me able to accept the fact that she retired...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Still... I suppose even Haruka had to have been a regular girl before she became an idol, right?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Haruka has given me so much hope for tomorrow.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I've only ever been on the receiving end though, and she's given me more than enough.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Now it's my turn. If this is the path she's chosen, then I'll try to support her in my heart!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I can't hide from this! I have to accept the choice Haruka has made!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And maybe one day I'll be able to take all the hope Haruka has given to me and pay it forward!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll just have to work more and more to become the kind of idol who can do that!
After school

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Hey, let's see if Haruka wants to walk with us! We can ask her all about what's it's like to be a celebrity!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: We can't do that. Nobody just stops being famous for no reason. I'll bet it's something she'd rather not talk about.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I figured this kind of thing would happen, but still...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I wonder if there's somewhere quiet around here.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: All right, today's been a bit crazy, but it's time to pull myself together and get back to practicing dancing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I usually stick to ASRUN songs, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I think I'll go with a Miku song today!
Her lyrics always cheer me up!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka?!
